studio.title: Safety & Studio
studio.subtitle: Your health and comfort are our highest priority
studio.section_env_text: Our private home studio is kept spotlessly clean. Surfaces are wiped between every appointment, and the air is freshened before you arrive.
studio.section_tools_text: All metal implements are autoclave-sterilized. Buffers, files, and single-use items are discarded after each client.
studio.step1_desc: All surfaces, lamps, and armrests are wiped with hospital-grade disinfectant before each appointment.
studio.step2_desc: Cuticle pushers, nippers, and other metal tools are autoclave-sterilized between every client.
studio.step3_desc: Nail files, buffers, and cotton pads are single-use and discarded after every appointment.
studio.step4_desc: Hands are washed and sanitized before touching any client's nails.
studio.studio_promise: Your safety is not an afterthought — it's built into every appointment.

studio.title: 安全与工作室
studio.subtitle: 您的健康与舒适是我们的首要考量
studio.section_env_text: 我们的私人家庭工作室保持一尘不染。每次预约之间都会擦拭消毒所有台面，并在您到来前进行空气净化。
studio.section_tools_text: 所有金属工具均经过高压灭菌器消毒。一次性用品如磨皮块、指甲锉等在每位客户使用后立即丢弃。
studio.step1_desc: 每次预约前，所有台面、灯具和扶手均用医院级消毒剂擦拭消毒。
studio.step2_desc: 推皮器、剪钳等金属工具在每位客户之间进行高压灭菌处理。
studio.step3_desc: 指甲锉、磨皮块和棉片均为一次性使用，每次预约后立即丢弃。
studio.step4_desc: 在接触任何客户指甲之前，均进行洗手和消毒处理。
studio.studio_promise: 您的安全不是事后才考虑的 — 它融入了每一次预约之中。
